subject: learning/code-pyxis-startup-worktree-harnesses
statement: The sourceable startup suite isolates fresh interactive sessions for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode. Thin harness adapters classify each CLI's pass-through commands, option arity, project target, and path-bearing arguments; the shared worktree module admits only an interactive top-level launch from a .pyxis-adopted primary checkout, fetches origin/main, creates a no-track chore branch in a sibling linked worktree, preserves caller-relative paths, and launches there.
intent: Give every supported interactive agent harness the same safe worktree lifecycle without changing headless, resume, utility, editor, or already-isolated invocations.
rationale: Repository and Git lifecycle behavior belongs in one sourceable implementation, while harness-specific command grammars remain explicit and fail through unchanged when syntax is unknown or ambiguous.
fit_criterion: Race-enabled pseudo-terminal tests exercise real Git repositories for all four harnesses, repository discovery from their native target options, relative-path preservation, pass-through modes and exit status, fetch failure, and optional comparisons with installed CLI help and version output without submitting prompts.

provenance.note: Semantic memory for the shared multi-harness startup worktree implementation merged from main.
